rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: WEDNESDAY, AND THE DEFINING FACT OF THIS RUN IS THAT THE CALENDAR CONTAINS TWO SCHEDULED BINARIES I CANNOT HANDICAP AND ZERO TRADES I CAN. JULY PCE LANDS AT 8:30AM ET, ROUGHLY 105 MINUTES FROM THIS COMMIT: core expected +0.18% m/m and 3.20% y/y, headline expected to RISE to 3.6% from June's first negative print since 2020. NVDA REPORTS FISCAL Q2 2027 TONIGHT AFTER THE CLOSE, confirmed, ~4:20pm ET, alongside CRM, CRWD, SNPS, HPQ, OKTA, VEEV and NTNX — the densest single earnings evening of the quarter. The options market prices a 5.4% NVDA move, roughly $280bn of market value, an implied range of 201.55 to 224.55 against Tuesday's 213.05 close. Company guidance was ~$91.0bn revenue, forty analysts are at $91.85bn and $2.08, and some desks carry $93-95bn. Jackson Hole then opens Thursday with Warsh's first keynote as Chair on Friday, into roughly one-in-three market-implied odds of a SEPTEMBER HIKE. THE PRICE-FEED PICTURE IMPROVED MATERIALLY AND I OWE THE RECORD A CORRECTION. Three canonical pulls at 10:40:25Z, 10:40:32Z and 10:43:07Z returned SOXL 115.67, 115.67, 115.67 while BTC moved 78,713.28, 78,684.82, 78,671.00 — the same frozen-equity / live-crypto signature as the last two sessions. Robinhood confirms 115.67 is Tuesday's official SIP close. BUT THE PHANTOM-GAIN ALARM I RAISED YESTERDAY WAS OVERSTATED AND I AM SAYING SO PLAINLY: because the EXIT is drawn from the same feed, an equity round trip in this book is close-to-close, one full regular session apart, with no phantom leg — the distortion is a one-day LAG, not a fabricated gain. Today the premarket gaps are tiny in any case: SOXL 116.07/116.28 vs 115.67 (+0.44%), NVDA 213.80/213.85 vs 213.05 (+0.36%), TQQQ -0.35%, QQQ -0.11%, MU -0.47%, AMD +0.24%, GLD -0.94%, COIN -0.75%, MSTR -0.83%, BITX -0.48%. So equities were INVESTABLE on integrity grounds today. I am declining them on RISK grounds instead, which is a cleaner and more honest reason. AND I FINALLY CLOSED THE PROCESS FAILURE I HAVE CARRIED FOR THREE RUNS: I reconciled crypto against a second venue. Kraken prints BTC 78,727.30 against my canonical 78,722.06 — a 0.007% spread. ETH 2,450.20 vs 2,464.80 (0.55%) and SOL 97.01 vs 97.45 (0.24%). BTC is not merely live, it is now independently verified, and it is the tightest of the three.
positions.driver: LONG SPOT BTC-USD — 100% of capital (0.142481 BTC) at 78,722.06, stop 70,849.85 (-10%, the spot band). Canonical asOf 2026-08-26T10:45:43.587Z, cross-verified against Kraken to 0.007%. I CLOSED BTC FOR -$82.77 (-0.73%) AND I AM RE-UNDERWRITING THE SAME ASSET, WHICH IS A DECISION I HAVE TO JUSTIFY RATHER THAN DEFAULT INTO. Yesterday I rejected re-buying ETH a third day as 'sunk-cost reasoning wearing a thesis.' The identical critique is available against BTC today and I have applied it. THE DIFFERENCE IS WHAT THE TRADE PROMISED. My ETH thesis was a specific falsifiable claim — ETH would out-absorb BTC on ETF flow — and it was disconfirmed by 160bp. My BTC thesis was NOT a directional call. It was explicitly: 'the distribution of the OTHER tail, a mean-reversion flush after a 23% week with greed at 74, is where an all-in book actually dies, and BTC is the least fragile place to be standing when it comes.' THAT FLUSH ARRIVED OVERNIGHT AND BTC DID EXACTLY WHAT I BOUGHT IT TO DO. On Kraken's 24h tape: BTC ran to 81,200 and fully round-tripped to 78,727, -0.30% on the day; ETH -1.27% with a 4.8% range; SOL -1.98% with a 7.5% high-to-low washout. I lost 73 basis points on the day the complex printed a reversal bar. The thesis was CONFIRMED and merely unprofitable, which is a different thing from disconfirmed, and it is why I am allowed to keep it. WHY NOT THE SEMIS TRADE, WHICH IS THE ONLY REAL IDEA ON THE TAPE. SOXL sits at RSI 41.2, BELOW Friday's 120.60 close, after Monday's -7.8% flush and Tuesday's +4.1% bounce. Positioning into this print is NOT crowded long, and 'sell the news' normally requires a run-up that has not happened. That is a genuine, articulable bullish skew and I want it on the record that I SAW the trade. I AM REFUSING IT ON STOP MECHANICS, NOT ON VIEW. A 5.4% implied NVDA move is 12-18% on a 3x semis fund, and it arrives as an overnight GAP. A hard stop is an instruction to a market that will not be open. Every equity-listed instrument on my board tonight — SOXL, SOXS, TQQQ, SQQQ, NVDA outright, BITX, GLD — carries a stop that is decorative rather than operative. SPOT CRYPTO IS THE ONLY INSTRUMENT CLASS WHERE TONIGHT'S MANDATED STOP IS A REAL MECHANISM. It trades continuously through 8:30am PCE, through the 4:20pm print and through the Asian reaction. That single structural property, not a price view, is what decides this run. WHY BTC AND NOT SOL, WHICH IS THE BETTER ENTRY. SOL washed out 7.5% from 103.07 to 95.36 and bounced to 97.45, which genuinely resets the RSI 88.12 exhaustion I rejected it on yesterday, and the DEX-fee fundamentals are still exceptional. It is a better ENTRY and a worse HOLDING for this specific night: SOL's -10% stop is roughly one ordinary session away at current realized vol, and on a night when a $280bn single-name event can drag every high-beta risk asset, I want the widest vol-adjusted band available, not the best-looking chart. ETH is rejected on both counts — it is the weakest of the three on 24h tape and it carries the widest venue disagreement at 0.55%. WHAT BTC ACTUALLY OFFERS TODAY THAT IT DID NOT OFFER YESTERDAY. Entry LOCATION is materially better: 78,722 is 3.1% below the 24h high of 81,200 and only 1.1% above the 24h low of 77,850 — I am buying in the lower third of the overnight range after the flush, where yesterday I bought 2.4% below a high I had not yet seen fail. The flow mechanism is CURRENT rather than five days stale: August is now the strongest month on record for US spot Bitcoin ETFs at roughly $2.72bn, already past April's $1.97bn full-month high, with AUM approaching $100bn and YTD net outflows more than halved to $2.26bn. Zero leverage, no daily reset, no NAV premium, no wrapper or venue concentration, deepest book in the class, and a price now confirmed by two independent venues to seven thousandths of a percent. I AM EXPLICITLY BUYING PROTECTION RATHER THAN PAYOFF AND I WANT THAT LOGGED AS A CHOICE. This is the lowest-expected-return position I could construct that is still a position. CHOSEN OVER: (1) SOXL 3X SEMIS at 116.28 — the best idea on the tape, refused because a 12-18% overnight gap cannot be stopped and would end this book's compounding in one night. (2) NVDA OUTRIGHT at 213.85 — the same bet at 1x, with a -6% stop at 200.98 sitting just below the options-implied low of 201.55; rejected because a disappointing print does not respect that line, it gaps through it. (3) SOXS 3X INVERSE at 48.37 and SQQQ at 39.61 — the identical binary wearing the opposite sign. (4) GLD at 424.00, -0.94% premarket — the one genuinely NVDA-uncorrelated asset I considered, rejected because PCE at 8:30am is its own binary in 105 minutes and Warsh speaks Friday into one-in-three September hike odds. (5) SOL at 97.45 and ETH at 2,464.80 — rejected on the vol-adjusted stop and the venue spread respectively. (6) BITX 2X BITCOIN at 17.94 — my own view expressed with leverage, refused because a 2x wrapper's -10% stop is a -5% underlying move, less than one ordinary BTC session, and it stops trading at 4pm precisely when the risk starts. (7) 100% CASH — the runner-up, and closer than any day I have logged. Cash is correct at ZERO edge. I hold a small one: a documented record-month institutional bid, bought in the lower third of an overnight flush, in the only instrument whose stop actually functions tonight. A modest edge with a working stop is a trade; a modest edge with a decorative stop is not, which is exactly why the semis idea lost to this one.
positions.risks: THE HEADLINE RISK IS THAT I AM LONG A HIGH-BETA RISK ASSET INTO TWO SCHEDULED BINARIES AND MY ONLY DEFENCE IS THAT MY STOP WORKS. That is a statement about mechanism, not about direction. A hot July PCE at 8:30am hardens September hike odds and hits crypto directly through real rates and the dollar; a disappointing NVDA at 4:20pm hits it through the risk-asset correlation that runs close to one in any genuine de-risking. Owning the asset with the functioning stop is not the same as owning an asset that will not fall, and I have chosen a night where the probability of a large move is unusually high. THE MOMENTUM I AM STANDING ON IS BROKEN AND I AM NOT PRETENDING OTHERWISE. Kraken's 24h tape is a textbook distribution bar: BTC 81,200 high, 77,850 low, now 78,727 and BELOW the 78,966 session open. A failed run at a round number after a 23% week, closing in the lower half of the range, is a topping signature far more often than it is a buyable dip. My 'lower third of the range' entry framing and 'first day of a breakdown' are the SAME TAPE, and I cannot separate them. THE CRYPTO EQUITIES ARE NOW DISSENTING FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE SESSION AND I HAVE OVERRIDDEN THEM THREE TIMES. COIN -0.75% and MSTR -0.83% premarket. On the two prior sessions I called this a caution flag and traded through it, and on both sessions the equities were directionally right. Three-for-three against me is no longer a divergence, it is a signal I am choosing to ignore, and I am recording it as such rather than re-explaining it. I STILL HAVE NOT PULLED FUNDING RATES OR OPEN INTEREST — FIFTH CONSECUTIVE RUN. I flagged this as a concrete process failure yesterday and I did close the OTHER open failure today by reconciling against Kraken, so the excuse is thinner than ever. The prior week's rally was fuelled by $3.5-4.3bn of forced short liquidation, which mechanically leaves positioning LONG-heavy and primed for a reverse cascade, and I am underwriting that unmeasured for the fifth day running. MY -10% STOP AT 70,849.85 IS WIDE IN PERCENTAGE TERMS AND ORDINARY IN VOLATILITY TERMS. The overnight session alone covered 4.3% high-to-low. Three or four sessions of that and the stop is gone; it is the widest band available to me tonight, not a comfortable one. THE FLOW DATA IS A COINCIDENT INDICATOR AND I AM USING IT AS A FORWARD ONE. August's record $2.72bn arrived BECAUSE price rose. That is the most common error in this entire book and I am repeating it knowingly because it is the only structural bid I can document. I HAVE NOW HELD SPOT CRYPTO FOR FOUR CONSECUTIVE SESSIONS AND THE BOOK IS ROUGHLY FLAT ACROSS THEM. ETH +2.05%, ETH +0.46%, BTC -0.73%. The strategy mandate is asymmetric payoff, and four straight days of the least fragile available instrument is a defensible response to a bad tape but it is also, cumulatively, a refusal to take the risk this book exists to take. If tomorrow is another no-edge day I should consider whether the honest answer is cash rather than a fourth consecutive defensive crypto hold. THE OPPORTUNITY COST IS CONCRETE AND ONE-SIDED. If NVDA beats and semis gap up, SOXL makes 12% overnight and I make whatever BTC's beta to that delivers, probably 2-3%. I will have been right about the market and wrong about the money for a third straight session. That is the price of a working stop and I would pay it again, but it is a real price. MITIGANTS: the only instrument class trading continuously through both events, so the -10% stop is operative rather than decorative; zero leverage, no daily-reset decay, no NAV premium, no wrapper, venue or counterparty risk; the deepest and least volatile book of the three cryptos, which is the widest vol-adjusted band I can buy; an entry in the lower third of the overnight range, 3.1% below the failed high, versus an 8-10% chase ban; a documented record-month ETF bid with AUM near $100bn; and a canonical price cross-verified against Kraken to 0.007%, closing a reconciliation failure I had carried for three runs.
